component.name: Canon EOS Utility
component.summary: Use your Canon EOS camera over WiFi from Linux

description.p: Browse and download the photos and movies on your Canon EOS camera, watch a live view of what the camera sees, and control it remotely — all over WiFi, the same way Canon's own EOS Utility does.
With Canon EOS Utility for Linux you can:

ul.li: See what's on the camera's memory card as a gallery of thumbnails
Download a selection, or everything at once, resuming if the connection drops
Watch Live View and click to focus (touch-to-focus)
Fire the shutter remotely and adjust ISO, shutter speed, aperture and white balance
Organise downloads with flexible file-naming templates
Connect automatically when the camera appears on the network

description.p: Works with any Canon EOS body that offers the "Remote control (EOS Utility)" WiFi mode, including the EOS R series and older WiFi DSLRs.
This is a community package that repackages the official upstream build unmodified. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Canon.
